details: Published a universal signed and notarized DMG from source commit 0e9a4242b. Since 1.0.76: TK-350 5 kHz channels decoded and written by their byte-13 step bits, CTCSS tone writes, and frequency edits no longer refused by the tone check; UV-5RM Pro handshake follows CPS v1.12 (19200 announce first, stray bytes before the ACK skipped); Quansheng TK11 upload opens its own session and checks every block; every lib/ function documented. Verification: analyzer clean; 257 Flutter tests; 701 Python tests passed (2 fixture skips); embedded version 1.0.77 / 77; arm64 and x86_64; 278 driver modules; bundled kpg23, 5rh_pro, tk11_upload and bridge match source; strict codesigning and Gatekeeper (Notarized Developer ID) accepted for the DMG and mounted app; local/server/public SHA-256 matched. Artifact SHA-256: 1feead825b8d8a9e2fc5c3ec5181139babc2d17008007ed908a2718cad7d879c. Apple notarization: 8e4766d8-b1ba-48ba-b9db-81f3fdab5206. The live manifest reports macOS 1.0.77.
